takes.text: This comet is leaving the Sun, and its tail is in front.
Dust and gas stream off the head as it warms.
So what is pushing them the other way?
Watch single dust grains glint as sunlight knocks them loose from the crust.
See the ions glow blue and spiral along the Sun's magnetic field lines.
Now the field lines snap and reconnect, and a knot of plasma breaks off the tail.
So the tail always points away from the Sun.
The tail is showing you the wind.
